Add LifeGridView

Life Grid shows your life in months, where gray squares are the past and pink squares are the future.
Add README and AGENTS files

Overlay consumed and burned series in calories chart

Updated the CaloriesBalanceView to display both consumed and burned calorie series on the same chart using different symbols and colors. Added interpolation for smoother lines, adjusted the X scale to fit both series, and enabled the chart legend for better clarity.

Add CaloriesBalanceView to Health Insights tab

Introduces CaloriesBalanceView for visualizing daily calories burned and consumed, including a chart and date range selection. Updates the project file to include the new view and adds an 'Insights' tab in TabBarView to access it.

Filter categories in HealthMetricsToggleView

Added a filteredCategories property to only display categories with available metrics or advanced metrics. Updated the ForEach loop to use filteredCategories instead of all categories.

Move LifeExpectancyView components to subfolder

Refactored the project structure by moving LifeExpectancyView.swift, LifelineView.swift, MarkerProgressView.swift, ProgressBarView.swift, and TextBubble.swift into a new LifeExpectancyView subfolder. Updated the Xcode project file to reflect the new file locations for better organization.

Refactor HealthExportViewModel for dependency injection

Introduced the HealthCSVWriting protocol and updated HealthCSVWriter to conform to it. HealthExportViewModel now accepts a HealthCSVWriting dependency via its initializer, improving testability and flexibility. Updated HealthExportView to inject HealthCSVWriter and cleaned up metrics selection persistence.

Move metrics selection saving to ViewModel property observer

Shifted the call to saveMetricsSelection() from the view's .onChange modifier to the didSet observer of metricsToExport in HealthExportViewModel. This centralizes state management within the ViewModel and simplifies the view code.

Refactor date normalization in HealthExportViewModel

Moved date normalization logic for start and end dates into property observers and private methods in HealthExportViewModel. Removed explicit .onChange handlers for start and end in HealthExportView, simplifying the view code. Metrics selection saving is now handled directly via the view model.

Refactor HealthExportView and ViewModel initialization

Moved metrics loading and available metrics fetching to HealthExportViewModel's initializer, removing redundant onAppear and setAvailableMetrics methods. Refactored HealthExportView to extract main content, progress view, and metrics selection into separate computed properties for improved readability and maintainability.

Move HealthMetric+ToggleElement to Domain module

Relocated HealthMetric+ToggleElement.swift from Data/HealthKit to Domain to better reflect its domain-level responsibilities. Updated project file references accordingly.

Inject HealthMetricReading into HealthCSVWriter

Refactored HealthCSVWriter to accept a HealthMetricReading dependency via its initializer, improving testability and flexibility. Updated HealthExportViewModel to provide HealthMetricReader when creating HealthCSVWriter.

Refactor HealthKit files and introduce HealthMetricReading

Removed HealthKitManager and renamed HealthKitReader to HealthMetricReader, moving HealthMetric to a new Domain module. Introduced the HealthMetricReading protocol to abstract HealthMetricReader functionality and updated project references accordingly. This improves code organization and separation of concerns.

Refactor HealthKitReader and add CSVWritingFactory

Renamed HealthKitReader to HealthMetricReader for clarity and consistency. Introduced a CSVWritingFactory protocol and its implementation to decouple CSV writer creation, updating HealthCSVWriter and related view models to use dependency injection. Updated all usages and initializations to reflect these changes.

Add CSVWriting protocol and update CSVWriter

Introduced a new CSVWriting protocol to define a common interface for CSV writers. Updated CSVWriter to conform to this protocol and added the new protocol file to the project. Minor cleanup in HealthCSVWriter to remove an unused variable.

Refactor CSV writing and add HealthCSVWriter

Refactored CSVWriter to focus on generic CSV file writing and moved HealthKit-specific logic to a new HealthCSVWriter struct. Added a Double+ToString utility for consistent double-to-string conversion. Updated HealthExportViewModel to use HealthCSVWriter for exporting health data.

Remove CSV.swift and refactor CSVWriter for CSV output

Deleted the CSV.swift file and migrated CSV building and escaping logic into CSVWriter.swift. CSVWriter now handles CSV header and row generation internally, removing the dependency on the previous CSV and CSVStream structs. Updated file creation and row writing logic for improved encapsulation and maintainability.

Reset CURRENT_PROJECT_VERSION to 0 in project settings

The CURRENT_PROJECT_VERSION was changed from 2 to 0 in the Xcode project configuration. This may be to reset the build versioning for the project.

Filter toggles by available IDs in ToggleView

Updated ToggleView to only display elements and advanced toggles whose IDs are present in the available set. This ensures that only available toggles are shown and managed, improving UI consistency and preventing unavailable options from being displayed.

Show only available HealthKit metrics for export

Added logic to detect and display only HealthKit metrics with available data in the export view. Updated HealthKitReader to provide available metrics, refactored HealthExportViewModel, and propagated available metrics through HealthExportView, HealthMetricsToggleView, and ToggleView.

Bump MARKETING_VERSION to 2.1

Updated the MARKETING_VERSION from 2.0 to 2.1 in the Xcode project file for all relevant targets to reflect the new release version.

Refactor HealthExportView to move logic into ViewModel

Moved state management, persistence, and export logic from HealthExportView into HealthExportView.ViewModel. This improves separation of concerns, simplifies the view, and makes the code more maintainable by centralizing business logic in the ViewModel.

Refactor HealthExportView to use ViewModel

Moved state management logic from HealthExportView to a new HealthExportView.ViewModel class for better separation of concerns and improved code organization. Updated all references in HealthExportView to use the ViewModel properties and methods. Added HealthExportView+ViewModel.swift to the project.

Add method to check for HealthKit data existence

Introduces hasData(for:) to HealthKitReader, allowing asynchronous checks for the presence of any HealthKit samples for a given HealthMetric. This helps determine if HealthKit contains data for a specific metric before attempting further queries.

Normalize and clamp export date range selection

Added logic to ensure the start and end dates for export are normalized to the start of the day, clamped to not exceed today, and kept in a valid range (start <= end). This prevents users from selecting invalid or future dates.

Skip leading empty rows in CSV export

Added logic to omit leading rows where all metric columns are empty when writing CSV files. This ensures the exported CSV starts with the first non-empty data row, improving data clarity.

Remove unused write method from CSVWriter

Deleted the async write(metrics:date:) method, which is no longer used. This helps clean up the CSVWriter struct and reduces code redundancy.

Add specific system images for HealthMetric cases

Replaced the default 'heart' system image in HealthMetric's ToggleElement extension with case-specific SF Symbols for each health metric. This improves the UI by providing more relevant icons for each metric type.
Update project.pbxproj

Refine Nutrition metrics in HealthMetricCategory

Moved dietarySugar, dietaryFiber, dietaryFatSaturated, and dietarySodium from the main Nutrition metrics to the advanced list. This change clarifies the distinction between basic and advanced nutrition metrics.
Merge branch 'main' of github.com:vlad92z/lifeline

Refactor health metrics and categories structure

Renamed and reorganized several health metrics, such as changing 'heartRate' to 'maxHeartRate' and updating 'physicalEffort' to 'Max Effort (kcal/hr·kg)'. Adjusted HealthMetricCategory groupings to better separate basic and advanced metrics, and updated aggregation logic to support new metric types like discreteMax. Also improved mapping and unit handling for new and existing metrics.

Persist metric selection in HealthExportView

Adds logic to save and load the selected health metrics using UserDefaults, ensuring user selections persist across app launches in the export view.

Add more data types to HealthKit authorisation view

Expanded the list of HealthKit data types shown in the authorisation view by adding Active Energy, Nutrition, and Exercise, and reorganized the display into two columns for better readability.

Remove comments from HealthKitAuthorisationView

Cleaned up HealthKitAuthorisationView.swift by removing unnecessary inline comments to improve code readability.

Refactor export views and add HealthExportRootView

Renamed ExportView to HealthExportView and HealthKitAccessView to HealthKitAuthorisationView for clarity. Introduced HealthExportRootView to manage the flow between authorisation and export. Updated TabBarView to use the new root view.

Refactor HealthKit authorization and add access view

Removed HealthKitAuthorizer and integrated authorization logic into HealthKitReader with async support. Added HealthKitAccessView for improved user experience when requesting HealthKit permissions. Updated ExportView to remove direct authorization UI and logic.

Rename 'Share CSV' button to 'Export CSV'

Updated the button label in ExportView from 'Share CSV' to 'Export CSV' for clarity and consistency with export functionality.
Update README.md

Add .gitignore for Xcode project

Introduces a .gitignore file to Lifeline.xcodeproj to exclude build artifacts, user-specific files, dependency manager directories, logs, secrets, and other generated files from version control.

Update InfoPlist keys and project version settings

Added NSHealthUpdateUsageDescription and LSApplicationCategoryType InfoPlist keys for better health data access descriptions and compliance. Set CURRENT_PROJECT_VERSION to 0 for WidgetExtension targets.

Update project and marketing version numbers

Set CURRENT_PROJECT_VERSION to 0 and update MARKETING_VERSION to 2.0 for main targets and extensions in the Xcode project configuration.

Handle optional HealthKit values in CSV export

Updated HealthKitReader to return optional Double values for metrics, reflecting missing data as nil instead of defaulting to 0. Adjusted CSVWriter and CSV line generation to handle optional string values, ensuring missing data is represented as empty cells in CSV output. This improves data accuracy and prevents misleading zero values in exported CSVs.

Refactor CSV export date handling and HealthKit queries

Updated CSVWriter to use a DateFormatter for date columns and refactored the daily iteration logic. Simplified HealthKitReader by removing the dailySeries method and renaming dailyValue(for:from:to:) to value(for:from:to:). ExportView now initializes start and end dates to the start of the current day for consistency. Added debug prints for start and end dates in ExportView.

Remove unused caloriesConsumed and CSV export methods

Deleted the caloriesConsumed method and a commented-out CSV export function from HealthKitReader.swift as they are no longer in use. This helps clean up the codebase and improve maintainability.

Add selected metrics text and HealthKit request button

Introduces a computed property to display selected metrics or a prompt when none are selected. Also adds a toolbar button to request HealthKit authorization from the export view.

Refactor export and metrics selection UI

Updated ExportView to use NavigationStack and List with sections for metrics and date range, improving navigation and layout. Refactored HealthMetricsToggleView to remove internal NavigationStack and dismiss logic, delegating navigation to the parent view. This streamlines the export flow and aligns with SwiftUI navigation best practices.

Show selected metrics in ExportView

Displays the currently selected metrics as a comma-separated list in the ExportView, providing users with immediate feedback on their selection.

Rename 'Turn Off All' button to 'Disable All'

Updated the button label in HealthMetricsToggleView for clarity and consistency by renaming 'Turn Off All' to 'Disable All'.

Move 'All On/Off' button to section header

The 'All On/Off' toggle button has been relocated from the advanced section to the main section header for better visibility and usability. This change streamlines the UI and ensures the button is always accessible regardless of advanced options.

Refactor metric selection to use categories

Updated HealthMetricsToggleView to accept and display HealthMetricCategory groups instead of a flat list of metrics. Adjusted ExportView and ToggleView to support this new structure, improving organization and user experience for selecting metrics, including advanced toggles and batch selection controls.

Improve advanced section toggle in ToggleView

Changed the default state of showAdvanced to false and replaced the expandable Section with a custom header and show/hide button for the advanced section. This provides a clearer and more accessible way to toggle advanced options.

Refactor and expand toggle views, add categories

Renamed ToggleView to HealthMetricsToggleView and moved related files to a new ToggleView directory. Added a new generic ToggleView supporting advanced elements and categories. Updated HealthMetricCategory with additional fitness, activity, and environment categories. Updated ExportView to use HealthMetricsToggleView.

Add HealthMetricCategory model

Introduced the HealthMetricCategory struct to group health metrics into categories, including support for advanced metrics. Updated the Xcode project to include the new HealthMetricCategory.swift file.

Refactor HealthMetric enum and update HealthKit mapping

Reorganized the HealthMetric enum for improved logical grouping and clarity, adding new categories and reordering cases. Updated HealthMetric+HealthKit to adjust unit and aggregation mappings, including setting timeInDaylight to use seconds and cumulativeSum, and consolidating aggregation logic for related metrics.

Refactor metric selection with sheet and navigation

ExportView now uses a button to present metric selection in a sheet, improving UI clarity. ToggleView is updated to support a title, navigation stack, and a toolbar with 'Done' and 'Turn On/Off All' actions for better user experience.

Add comprehensive HealthKit metrics support

Expanded HealthMetric enum and HealthMetric+HealthKit mapping to include a wide range of HealthKit metrics, covering body measurements, activity, cardio, mobility, nutrition, and other health data. Updated unit and aggregation logic to support new metrics, enabling broader HealthKit data integration.

Add new HealthMetric cases and HealthKit mappings

Introduces new HealthMetric cases: sleepingTemp, bodyFat, bodyMassIndex, electroDermalActivity, height, and leanBodyMass. Updates HealthMetric+HealthKit to provide appropriate HKQuantityTypeIdentifier, HKUnit, and HKStatisticsOptions mappings for these new metrics.

Add loading indicator during CSV export

Introduces an isExporting state to disable the export button and display a progress overlay while the CSV is being prepared for sharing. This improves user feedback during potentially long export operations.

Remove unused state properties from ExportView

Cleaned up ExportView by removing unused @State properties related to mail and CSV data, simplifying the view's state management.

Refactor metric selection with ToggleView and cleanup

Replaces individual metric toggles in ExportView with a reusable ToggleView component, introducing ToggleElement protocol and related views. Removes CompoundHealthMetric and updates HealthMetric to be Identifiable and Hashable, simplifying metric selection and export logic. Updates project structure and TabBarView order accordingly.

Add streaming CSV export and compound metric support

Introduces CSVStream for efficient streaming CSV writing and updates CSVWriter to support exporting multiple HealthMetrics over a date range. Adds CompoundHealthMetric type for combined metrics, and updates ExportView to allow selection of metrics and date range for export.

Add HealthMetric model and CSV export functionality

Introduces the HealthMetric enum and HealthMetric+HealthKit extension for mapping metrics to HealthKit types, units, and aggregation. Adds CSVWriter for exporting selected HealthKit metrics to CSV. Refactors HealthKitReader to support generic metric queries and parallel daily value fetching. Updates ExportView to allow users to select a date range and export health data as a CSV file via a share sheet.
